name: Chém theo vũ khí
desc: a SWORD smear that follows a real weapon swing: use it with --track (the tip's arc is the outer edge, the blade the inner); born one frame before the hit as a thin slice on the blade of pose A, whole on the hit frame with a white edge along the blade, the tail draws in at once; the tip strand is dense and lasts, the hilt strand is faint and goes first; set the hit frame of the fx on the character's hit frame

warn: pop: frame 8 -> 9 loses 46 % of the peak
linger: the last 8 of 18 frames carry under 2 % of the peak
